notes: Anomaly detection flags unusual observations; it is not a calibrated failure probability.
The detector never consumes ground-truth failure labels; they are used only here, for evaluation.
The AI4I dataset is synthetic and strongly imbalanced, so precision/recall are sensitive to the chosen threshold.
Thresholds are tuned on the validation split only; the test split is used once, for reporting.

completed_google_reports.scope: ID resolution and stored source checks; not proof of semantic entailment or physical root cause.

citation_id_resolution.limitation: Structural ID resolution, not semantic citation accuracy. Source mismatches and critic issues are reported separately.

saved_counterfactuals.scope: Stored/cited explicit and dependency-closed evidence IDs; does not prove absence of paraphrased leakage.

latency_seconds.scope: Stored completed Google-provider job start-to-completion durations; not a benchmark of current live capacity.

root_cause_top1_top3.reason: No independent machine-specific root-cause labels. AI4I failure flags are not hypothesis-ranking ground truth.
